name: How to play
notes: Four pages explaining the game, opened from the title menu. Returns to the title menu at the end.

lines.text: MOVE WITH THE D-PAD. YOUR WEAPONS ATTACK ON THEIR OWN: JUST DODGE!
MONSTERS DROP GEMS. GRAB THEM TO LEVEL UP, THEN PICK 1 OF 3 UPGRADES.
MAX A WEAPON AND OWN ITS PARTNER ITEM: IT CAN EVOLVE INTO SOMETHING FAR STRONGER.
GOLD BUYS POWER UPS THAT LAST FOREVER. SURVIVE 10 MINUTES AND DEFEAT THE NIGHT LORD!
